outcome: AHRR DNA methylation in cord blood
AHRR DNA methylation in maternal blood
cohort: This study involved 90 FT-LBW and 90 FT-NBW mother-infant pairs.
finding: AHRR DNA methylation in cord and maternal blood was independently associated with FT-LBW, with lower methylation in cord blood and higher methylation in maternal blood of FT-LBW infants.
